'''Nessl Vaccan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. During the [[war against Zakuul]] she became a member of the [[Eternal Alliance]] and traveled to the [[Alliance base]] on [[Odessen]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Nessl Vaccan appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' expansion as the Umbara flashpoint rewards vendor.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' {{1st}}
